in_sanskrit.name: Bikesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror of Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bikesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bikesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhagavat', meaning 'God'. The name Bikesh signifies a person who is the conqueror of the gods. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe.
